'''Hervey Douglas''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] as a military clerk during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="UCD" />

==Biography==
Douglas was based inside the [[Imperial Data Processing Facility]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tazan]] and along with the clerk [[Mir Vladick]], the Human was responsible for ensuring the orderly running of the facility's contingent of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]]. Sometime after the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction]] of the planet [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], the child [[Jastina Clines]] was imprisoned inside the Data Processing Facilty and Douglas and Vir took pity on her, so they smuggled some toys and [[Book/Legends|books]] into her cell, to keep her happy. A short time later, a team of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] agents [[Mission to Tazan|infiltrated]] the base and encountered Douglas and Vir, and the two clerks attempted to press an alarm button.<ref name="UCD">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=rpga/articles/rx20010816s|text=Ultimate Core Dump|int=Ultimate Core Dump}}</ref>
